incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: elevated TPM for model family 'nightwind-13b' in us-west-2 — sudden spike in requests and rising latencies. Ticket: INC-20260317-889
Jane (oncall): paging — I'm looking. Any customer-facing errors?
Emily (support): @Jane we've got ~6 support pings. AcmeCorp reports 504s when generating long completions.
Alex (SRE): seeing backend queueing on nightwind-13b. 95th latency up to 2.1s for token generation, and request error rate +2.3% since 06:12 UTC.
Jane (oncall): OK. Immediate mitigation: reduce per-model rates for nightwind-13b to limit tail load. Proposal: TPM -> 1800 (from 7200), RPM -> 90 (from 300). Thoughts?
Rachel (eng): that should reduce concurrent KV cache pressure. Might also need to disable funcall for that family; funcalls are spiking.
Alex (SRE): agree on quota cut. If we cut too hard we'll hit customer 429s but safer than higher error rate. Recommend also fallback routing to nightwind-6b-std for new requests.
Jane (oncall): I'll apply a soft cap first (gradual). Command I will run:```\nPOST /internal/admin/quota\n{\n  "model": "nightwind-13b",\n  "tpm": 1800,\n  "rpm": 90,\n  "mode": "soft"\n}\n```\nJane (oncall): applying now. Will follow up with function-call disable if it doesn't improve.
deploy-bot: quota update initiated by Jane (oncall) — change queued (change-id: q-4281-01)
Alex (SRE): watching metrics: throttles +35% immediately but overall token generation rate dropped ~65%. Backend queue length decreasing. Latency trending down.
Emily (support): AcmeCorp confirmed reduced errors, now seeing 200/OK responses but slower. They asked if this is temporary.
Jane (oncall): replying to customers: "We're temporarily shaping traffic on nightwind-13b to protect overall service. We're routing to compatible fallback models where possible. We'll update once traffic stabilizes."
Rachel (eng): I'm going to enable fallback routing rule for the model family:```\nPATCH /internal/routing\n{ "from": "nightwind-13b", "to": "nightwind-6b-std", "ratio": 0.25 }\n```\nRachel (eng): implemented. Starting small traffic shift.
Alex (SRE): metrics show request rate to nightwind-13b holding, and nightwind-6b traffic +18%. Error budget for affected customers preserved.
Jane (oncall): still seeing elevated funcall-related errors in logs. Next step: disable funcall for nightwind-13b only. Approving now.
Jane (oncall):```\nPOST /internal/feature-toggle\n{ "model": "nightwind-13b", "feature": "funcall", "enabled": false }\n```\ndeploy-bot: feature toggle applied (toggle-id: ft-4281-02)
Alex (SRE): after funcall off — error rate down to baseline, p95 token latency 0.85s. Looks stable.
Emily (support): updating customers that we're seeing stable service and restoring normal error rates; will monitor for regressions.
Sam (next-shift): @Jane can you summarize actions for handoff?
Jane (oncall): Handoff: 1) Quota (soft): nightwind-13b TPM=1800 RPM=90 (soft mode). 2) Fallback routing -> nightwind-6b-std at 25% traffic. 3) Funcall disabled for nightwind-13b. 4) Monitoring: watch p95 token latency and 5xx rates for next 2h. 5) Follow-up ticket INC-20260317-889 assigned to Rachel for root cause and perf regression PR.
Sam (next-shift): got it. I'll keep an eye and escalate if throttles cause customer 429s.
Rachel (eng): creating follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3129 — will capture perf regression and plan safe rollout of fixes.
Jane (oncall): thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic. Will reopen if we see new anomalies. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260317-889 status: mitigated (temporary controls applied).
